dataset.title: Enviro-HIRLAM output

dataset.description:
Case study: wildfires and dust storm air pollution events occured in April 2020 in the norther part of Ukraine (including the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone).
The presented dataset contains the seamless Environment – HIgh-Resolution Limited Area Model (Enviro-HIRLAM) model output with a 1.5 km horizontal resolution. Period of study cover 5-30 April 2020. The model domain consists of 410×410 grid points in a rotated system of coordinates. Extracted for the 11 lowest Enviro-HIRLAM model levels. The model description can be found by the following link: https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-10-2971-2017

Model configurations: (1) reference (REF) run without aerosol effects; (2) run with direct aerosol effects (DAE) included; (3) run with indirect aerosol effects (IDAE); and (4) run with combined direct and indirect aerosol effects (COMB).

Domain and rotated system characteristics:
- number of grid points along longitude = 410; 
- number of grid points along latitude = 410;
- south boundary in rotated system of coordinates (deg) =-27.484;
- north boundary in rotated system of coordinates = -21.349;
- west boundary in rotated system of coordinates = -35.450;
- east boundary in rotated system of coordinates = -29.315;
- coordinates of South pole - latitude (deg) = 0.0;
- coordinates of South pole - longitude =80.0

File format: NetCDF (converted from GRIB)

Example of file names: "met_fc20200405_00+003.nc", "metflux_fc20200405_00+003.nc", "aer_fc20200405_00+003.nc", where "20200405" is 5 April 2020; "00+003" is 03UTC.

Aerosols data description:
var138 - sulfur Aitken soluble
var139 - sulfur accumulation soluble
var144 - sulfur coarse soluble
var145 - black carbon Aitken soluble
var146 - black carbon accumulation soluble
var147 - black carbon coarse soluble
var148 - black carbon Aitken insoluble
var149 - organic carbon Aitken soluble
var150 - organic carbon accumulation soluble
var151 - organic carbon coarse soluble
var250 - organic carbon Aitken insoluble
var153 - sea salt accumulation soluble
var154 - sea salt coarse soluble
var155 - dust accumulation soluble
var156 - dust coarse soluble
var157 - dust accumulation insoluble
var158 - dust coarse insoluble

Meteorological data description:
var11 - temperature
var33 - u-wind 
var34 - v-wind
var51 - specific humidity
var58 - specific cloud ice
var61 - total precipitation
var71 - total cloud cover
var76 - specific cloud liquid water
var111 - net surface short-wave radiation
var112 - net surface long-wave radiation
var115 - downwelling surface long-wave radiation
var117 - downwelling global short-wave radiation
var200 - turbulent kinetic energy

dataset.title: WRF output

dataset.description:
Input data required to run the Enviro-HIRLAM model, set chemical & meteorological initial and boundary conditions; initialize assimilation procedure.
These data include:
- meteorological fields,
- land use/ land cover parameters,
- atmospheric composition;
- antropogenic and natural emissions.
dataset.title: Input for Enviro-HIRLAM model

dataset.description:
Input data required to run the Weather Research and Forecast (WRF) model, set atmospheric and surface layer conditions.
These data include:
- Meteorological fields,
- Land use/ land cover parameters,
- Surface layer fields,
- Topographic data.

format: NetCDF and specific WRF input geodata format

The Data Management Plan (DMP) for the Enviro-HIRLAM and WRF data created at the UHMI is developed in the context of effective management and processing data generated for CERTAINTY project.
The DMP for the Enviro-HIRLAM and WRF data at the UHMI is designed to maximize value, accessability and impact of the data produced supporting the institute's mission in advancing meteorological research and services.
